panels.caption: Earth time, 7:00 AM. I wake up from hyper-sleep. My 7-hour training mission at school begins.
By 4:00 PM, I dock at Home Base. I refuel with my crew (my family) for 1 hour and 15 minutes.
At 5:15 PM, the strict 'Focus Protocol' starts. I do my homework for exactly 1 hour until 6:15 PM.
Systems powering down. At 9:00 PM, I go to bed to recharge.
